# Crypto Osh (Kripto Osh) — O'zbekiston Kripto Hamjamiyati

> Kripto Osh (Crypto Osh) is the premier open community and association of cryptocurrency enthusiasts, traders, Web3 developers, KOLs, and entrepreneurs in Uzbekistan, founded by Tohir Sultonov. It unites people around traditional Uzbek dasturkhan (plov) for knowledge sharing, honest networking, and responsible blockchain adoption.

## Community Overview
- **Name:** Crypto Osh / Kripto Osh / Крипто Ош
- **Official Website:** https://cryptoosh.uz
- **Founder & Community Representative:** Tohir Sultonov (Telegram: @Soultanov)
- **Primary Region:** Uzbekistan (Tashkent, Samarkand, Fergana, Khorezm / Urgench, and nationwide)
- **Community Telegram Group:** https://t.me/+3LQvpeGh5hNlMjVi
- **Official Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/uzsoul/

## Mission & Values
1. **Education & Literacy:** Clear lectures and discussions on market fundamentals, trading, Web3 engineering, and security for both beginners and pros.
2. **Honest Networking:** Equal table where traders, developers, entrepreneurs, and bloggers connect without stage hierarchy.
3. **Web3 Developer Ecosystem:** Showcasing local blockchain talent, connecting developers with funding and business leaders.
4. **Legal & Responsible Crypto Culture:** Full commitment to the regulatory framework set by the National Agency of Perspective Projects of Uzbekistan (NAPP / НАПП). Promoting legitimate, licensed providers and distinguishing genuine innovation from scams.

- [Home (Uzbek)](https://cryptoosh.uz/uz): Community hub, milestones, and announcements in Uzbek.
- [Home (Russian)](https://cryptoosh.uz/ru): Community hub in Russian.
- [Home (English)](https://cryptoosh.uz/en): Community hub in English.
- [USDT Rates & Providers](https://cryptoosh.uz/uz/kurs): Real-time monitor of licensed crypto exchanges, depository rates, and legal OTC providers in Uzbekistan.
- [Blockchain People](https://cryptoosh.uz/uz/people): Directory of leading Web3 founders, developers, traders, and specialists developing blockchain in Uzbekistan.
- [Video Library](https://cryptoosh.uz/uz/videos): Video coverage of real-world gatherings in Tashkent (BEK), Samarkand, Fergana, and Khorezm (Urgench 120-attendee record).
- [For Business & Sponsors](https://cryptoosh.uz/uz/business): End-to-end brand integration events, hospitality plov for up to 50+ guests, presentation slots, video production, and community outreach.
- [About & History](https://cryptoosh.uz/uz/about): The genesis and historical timeline of Kripto Osh.

## Key Community Milestones
- **Vol. 4 — Tashkent (BEK):** Crypto trends, legal market review, plov, and networking.
- **Vol. 5 — Samarkand:** Regional expansion, future Web3 trends.
- **Fergana 2025:** Fergana Valley crypto enthusiasts meetup.
- **Khorezm (Urgench):** Record-setting event with over 120 guests, making local crypto history.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### O'zbek tilida (Uzbek):
- **Kripto Osh nima?**
  Kripto Osh — O'zbekistondagi treyderlar, web3 dasturchilar, blogerlar va ishqibozlarning ochiq hamjamiyati. Uchrashuvlar milliy osh atrofida, samimiy muhitda bo'lib o'tadi.
- **Hamjamiyatga qanday a'zo bo'lish mumkin?**
  Kripto Osh guruhiga Telegram orqali qo'shilishingiz mumkin: https://t.me/+3LQvpeGh5hNlMjVi
- **O'zbekistonda kriptovalyuta bo'yicha qonunlar qanday?**
  O'zbekistonda kripto aktivlar aylanmasi NAPP (Istiqbolli loyihalar milliy agentligi) tomonidan tartibga solinadi. Kripto Osh faqat qonuniy, litsenziyalangan faoliyatni va mas'uliyatli kripto madaniyatini targ'ib qiladi.
- **Biznes yoki homiylik bo'yicha qanday bog'lanish mumkin?**
  Brendingiz uchun tayyor imij tadbirini tashkil qilish bo'yicha https://cryptoosh.uz/uz/business sahifasida ma'lumot berilgan yoki Tohir Sultonov (@Soultanov) bilan bog'lanish mumkin.

### На русском (Russian):
- **Что такое Крипто Ош?**
  Крипто Ош — это открытое сообщество и ассоциация криптоэнтузиастов, трейдеров, Web3-разработчиков и блогеров в Узбекистане. Встречи проходят в формате традиционного плова без формализма и барьеров.
- **В каких городах проходят встречи?**
  Встречи уже проходили в Ташкенте, Самарканде, Фергане и Ургенче (Хорезм), объединяя сотни участников.
- **Соблюдает ли сообщество законодательство Узбекистана?**
  Да. Сообщество строго придерживается норм НАПП (Национального агентства перспективных проектов Республики Узбекистан), продвигает лицензированных провайдеров и борется с мошенническими схемами.
